root_idea.summary: The root centers on swallowing or taking in a small quantity of liquid.
root_idea.development: From this core develop the senses of a gulp or small draught, scant milk, the last breath near departure, and barren or rugged sand imagined as not being satisfied. The rope-twist sense is explicitly treated as a divergent branch.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form V perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To swallow or drink in successive small portions, with effort or difficulty; to gulp down something scarcely manageable.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic Form V usage concerns taking in a drink or liquid and emphasizes the effort involved in getting it down, rather than ordinary effortless drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swallow water; transitively, to swallow it, sometimes at once.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I, used for swallowing liquid, with both intransitive and transitive constructions attested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone swallow or drink; to give liquid gulp by gulp, sup by sup, or sip by sip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative action may involve forcing a drink down the throat, though it can also be non-coercive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone repress or restrain choking wrath or rage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative construction, representing the restraint of anger as making someone swallow it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a rope or bowstring have one or more strands thick, or thicker than the others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical description of the structure or manufacture of a rope or bowstring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repress or restrain choking wrath or rage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative Classical usage, portraying anger as something swallowed; this specialization is not separately established as Quranic in the supplied evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A twist or protrusion in one strand of a rope or bowstring that appears above the other strands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun describing an irregularity in the strand structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope or bowstring whose twisting is uneven, with one or more strand prominences projecting above the others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a rope or bowstring having the irregularity called جَرَعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gulp, sup, sip, or mouthful of water; the amount or single act swallowed at one time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can denote either the quantity taken in or the individual act of swallowing a drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom جُرَيْعَةُ الذَّقَنِ, a tiny sup at the chin, hence the last breath or the brink of destruction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression for someone who was at the point of destruction or death and then escaped.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, something swallowed of wrath or rage while it is repressed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Proverbial or figurative use extending the physical act of swallowing to the restraint of anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sandy tract, hill, or hillock, described variously as barren, rugged, or mixed with stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical descriptions vary: the term may refer to barren sand, a hard sandy tract, a rugged plain, or a hill with sand and stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel yielding only a few sups of milk because her udders contain little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is used of camels with this scant-milk condition.
